title: Neuron Monster Snow Globe
description: A glowing glass snow globe sits on a black base, containing colorful cartoonish neuron-like creatures with faces, tentacles, and dendrites in pink, blue, yellow and purple. A human finger points at the top of the sphere from the upper right.
prompt: A glowing transparent glass snow globe on a black pedestal base contains several cute but creepy cartoon neuron creatures with faces, big eyes, sharp teeth, and colorful dendrites and tentacles in pink, blue, yellow and purple. The neurons float inside the sphere connected by glowing lines, set against a dark moody background with dripping paint textures. A human finger touches the top of the globe. Cinematic lighting with vibrant neon glow, digital painting style.
